question: My house faces a 10 m wide street and will be 9 m tall. How much open space do I leave at the front?
gold: 3.6 m front open space. Rule 56(1)(a): street more than 9 m and up to 12 m, building up to 12.5 m height (PDF p.77).

question: I want a farm house on agricultural land. What is the minimum plot size and the maximum FAR?
gold: Minimum plot 0.40 hectare, maximum FAR 0.10. Rule 17(a),(b) (PDF p.34).

question: My development permission was granted in 2023. How long does it stay valid, and how many times can I renew it?
gold: Valid 3 years; revalidation for two consecutive terms of one year each (5 years max), then apply afresh. If work starts within validity it does not lapse. Rule 23 (PDF p.41).

question: I applied for building permission and the authority has not replied. What happens if they miss the deadline?
gold: Deemed sanctioned if refusal not intimated within the period in Section 30(5) of the Act, but not for applications to an authorised Architect/Structural Engineer, and nothing contrary to Act/Rules/Development Plan is authorised. Rule 28 (PDF p.48-49).

question: How far must my balcony stay from a low-voltage overhead electric line, vertically and horizontally?
gold: 2.5 m vertically, 1.2 m horizontally (or Electricity Rules if more). Rule 52(1) (PDF p.69).

question: Who is allowed to sign and submit my building plans?
gold: Licensed architect, structural engineer, engineer, supervisor or town planner, with name, qualification and licence number; owner also signs. Rule 18 (PDF p.34); scope by licence in Rule 26.

question: What documents go with an application for building permission?
gold: Application in Appendix A-2/A-2(1) with documents, plans and statements (Rule 14); details of information accompanying the application in Rule 16 (ownership documents, site plan, building plan, etc.).

question: What is the fee for building permission for a residential house?
gold: Application fee Rs 1 per sq m of proposed built-up area (21(2)(ii)) plus permission fee by slab of built-up area, e.g. Rs 750 up to 75 sq m ... Rs 50,000 above 2500 sq m (21(3)(b) item 1, PDF p.36).

question: Can I change my plan after it is sanctioned?
gold: Deviation not permissible if it affects front MOS, exceeds 30% of permissible FAR, parking/public utility, road alignment, water body (Rule 24). Addition/alteration in proposed plan up to 10%: Rs 500; above 10%: fresh application (Rule 21(3)(b) item 8).

question: What is the minimum rear open space for a 150 sq m residential plot?
gold: 1.50 m. Rule 56(2)(a): above 40 and up to 150 sq m (PDF p.78).

question: Do I need separate development permission for a 300 sq m plot that matches the Development Plan?
gold: Per the 28 Aug 2026 amendment to Rule 2(5)(c) (secondary source): for plots up to 500 sq m conforming to Development Plan land use, the local authority may permit construction; no separate development permission under 2(5)(a). Consolidated text: Rule 2(5)(c) (central area) - must flag version.

question: Which rule decides what happens when the Development Plan and these rules disagree?
gold: Rule 103: Development Plan norms apply; if different/contrary, the Director sends a proposal to the Government whose decision is final (PDF p.107).

question: What are the rules for lifts in a building taller than 15 m?
gold: Lifts required for buildings above 12.5 m; per NBC Part VIII Section 5; details in Appendix A-2(A) with application; completion report E-3(A); insurance; maintenance. Rule 83 (PDF p.95).

question: मेरा प्लॉट 200 वर्ग मीटर का है और सामने 9 मीटर चौड़ी सड़क है। आगे कितनी जगह खाली छोड़नी होगी?
gold: 3.0 मीटर (सड़क 9 मीटर तक). नियम 56(1)(a), PDF p.77.

question: बिल्डिंग परमिशन की फीस कितनी है और किस नियम में लिखी है?
gold: नियम 21: आवेदन शुल्क ₹1 प्रति वर्ग मीटर निर्मित क्षेत्र + अनुमति शुल्क स्लैब तालिका (21(3)(b)).
